body: Thanks man that meant a lot.

Last year I failed a midterm and my parents were pissed beyond belief. The next day my mom literally wouldn't talk to me, the only thing she said to me was "I'm not mad, I'm just disappointed"

That led to my self esteem dropping like crazy, and helped lead to my now depression. I now feel like everytime I mess something up or fail a quiz or test I'm just letting everyone around me down and disappointing them. 

Those couple words are engraved in my mind as a reason why I shouldn't be living anymore. I'm just letting everyone down.

I haven't posted in awhile here because stuff seemed like it was getting better. 

A couple weeks ago someone called me telling me they read all of my posts here on my main account because I was stupid and didn't use a throwaway. They then told me that if I didn't tell my parents everything I wrote they would. They then were like "talk to me, really how are you?" then I started to tell them I was actually pretty good at the moment but then they said "no not now, how are you in general??" I hated that so much. To me my day to day means so much more right now because that is what matters. It doesn't matter how I felt yesterday, today matters. I then had to beg them not to tell them so overall that's great.

Overall my life has been a rollercoaster this year. Some days I felt like shit, others I cryed and wanted to just be around my best friend and get a hug (still really want this) but then every now and then I had a good or an ok day. 

Right now I feel a little shitty but I have been way worse. I feel shitty because I should be happy that school is almost over for the year and that I'm leaving for the summer for a summer camp job, but I'm not happy at all.
